req.title: DELETE rejects unknown player
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 404 on DELETE for a non-existent playerId.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-015 requires DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number} to return HTTP 404 when the squad number does not exist. Violations in the previous response: test[7] had kind=negative but heuristic=EP (EP is for positive equivalence partitions; negative tests must use NEG or BVA/STC when appropriate); test[8] had kind=negative but heuristic=STC (STC is a state-transition heuristic that is neutral, not negative-specific, but the rule requires negative kind to pair with NEG heuristic unless BVA). Fix: test[7] heuristic changed from EP to NEG; test[8] heuristic changed from STC to NEG. All other tests are preserved exactly.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Squad number 10 (Messi) exists in the database
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — proves the 404 is conditional on non-existence, not a blanket response; kills mutations that always return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

r = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert r.status_code == 204
assert r.content == b''

tests.name: test_delete_nonexistent_player_returns_404

tests.name: test_delete_twice_second_call_returns_404
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 fixture rows
Squad number 5 (Paredes) exists in the database
actions: Send DELETE /players/squadnumber/5 (second call — player no longer exists after first deletion)
expected: Second call status code is exactly 404, not 204 or 200
trace: R-PLAYER-015 — NEG idempotency check; verifies that a second DELETE on the same squad number returns 404 after the resource has been removed; kills mutations that cache or ignore deletion state
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

r1 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r1.status_code == 204

r2 = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/5')
assert r2.status_code == 404
assert r2.status_code != 204
assert r2.status_code != 200
